szoveg_eredeti:
Paste your website. Ad Studio reads your brand and products, then makes ads with Krea 3.

Every product launch, restock and promotion needs new ads. Each one needs the right logo, the right colors, the right claims and the right size for where it runs. That is a lot of briefing for one static image.

Today we’re releasing Ad Studio. You give it your website. It reads your brand and your products, and it turns them into finished ads with Krea 3.

Ad Studio is the first Krea 3 Expert: a version of Krea 3 that is very good at one job. More Experts are on the way.

Paste your URL, check your brand kit and generate your first batch of ads with Krea 3.

Type your domain and press Enter. Ad Studio researches the site and builds a brand kit: logo, colors, fonts, a description, tone of voice, audience and selling points. It also finds your products, with photos and prices. For Shopify stores, it reads the product catalog.

The brand kit is yours to edit. Fix a color, delete an expired promotion, or rewrite a selling point. Every ad follows the kit, so the claims on your ads are the claims you approved.

No website yet? You can set up a brand by hand, or add products by link, by upload or by hand. A kit holds up to 20 products.

Choose where your ads will run. Each placement decides the sizes Ad Studio makes:

Then pick the products to advertise and how many ads to make for each, up to 12 in one batch. Each ad features one product and gets its own layout and copy.

You can also set a creative direction: let Krea choose, or ask for a product spotlight, the product in the real world, an editorial look, or an ad that explains why the product works.

Ad Studio passes your brand kit to Krea 3 on every ad. The product stays the product, down to the label, and the copy comes from your selling points.

Here is one kit and three ads it made. Ad Studio read DAVID’s site and found the serif wordmark, a black-and-white palette, the tagline “Protein has a new bar.” and selling points such as 28g of protein, 150 calories and 0g sugar. Those claims became the headlines.

Your ads open in a gallery next to Krea Agent. The Agent keeps your brand kit and your campaign in context. Ask for a new headline, a darker background, another product or another size, and it makes the change with Krea 3.

Preview any ad in a Facebook, Instagram or Reels mockup before it runs. Then download one ad, or the whole campaign as a ZIP.

We timed one full run on a real store. The brand kit was ready in 49 seconds. Six Story ads took 2 minutes 28 seconds. From pasting the URL to downloading the first ads took about five minutes. The full run is in our guide, How to Create Ecommerce Ads in 5 Minutes with AI.

Ad Studio works through the Krea MCP server too. Ask Claude to research a brand, pick products and generate ads, and it uses the same brand kits you see in Krea.

Ad Studio is live today at krea.ai/ad-studio on every paid plan, from Basic up. Brand research and product import are free. Ads use your compute units, like other Krea 3 generations.

Paste your website into Ad Studio and get a batch of on-brand ads made with Krea 3.

DAVID is used here as an example. The ads and screenshots were made in Ad Studio from the brand’s public website and aren’t affiliated with or endorsed by DAVID.
